cohort: 2702 women attending for delivery at Assiut University Hospital (tertiary) and Assiut Police Hospital (secondary) in Assiut Governorate, Egypt between January 2016 and March 2016.
finding: Robson Group 5 (previous caesarean delivery) contributed the most to the overall caesarean delivery rate in both hospitals, with a significantly higher percentage at the secondary hospital (74.8%) compared to the tertiary hospital (49.4%).
